{{Quote|Have you ever had stuffed sharrus, Luke?''"<br />"''No. We didn't have them where I grew up.''"<br />"''Well, you'll like them. Ah&mdash;a seafood stuffing, is it?|Vestin Axlon and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Stuffed sharru mushrooms''' were [[sharru mushroom]]s stuffed with a [[Foodstuff/Legends|seafood]] stuffing that included [[shell-crayke]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]'s [[Burnish Bay]]. The food could not be found on the<ref name="Choices" /> planet<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date-COC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Vestin Axlon]] [[Diet/Legends|ate]] stuffed sharrus at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on Poln Major.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stuffed sharru mushrooms appeared in ''[[Choices of One]]'', a [[2011]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
